For every vertical fan \(T_j\), P3K.89 proves \[ \begin{aligned} A_j={}&2b\binom{j+1}{3}+(3-b)\binom{j+1}{2} +k(a-1)(3p-1)-km\binom j2,\\ (k_M,\ell_M)={}&(\mu+6A_j,4\mu). \end{aligned} \] The full normal clutch used here is computed in P3K.86. P3K.90 transports these free integer data to every \(P\in\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb Z)\) by the actual two-ruling maps and the uniquely solved integral target-prism system. P3K.88 supplies explicit fixed-scalar fan witnesses for every element of \(\Theta_7\) on each branch. For the component-supported OS49 source, P3K.77--79 complete all one-cap lattice-basis fans, marked smooth order-one clutches and fixed-source holomorphic endpoints. P3K.81 supplies the exact integral obstructions for the additional smooth caps and good-II caps treated there. P3K.84--85 construct the two actual finite caps \(m=3k\), \(h=6l+1\) and their positive canonical return. With the full ordinary-clutch integer \(\sigma\), P3K.91 proves \[ D=hn_A+mn_B+mh\sigma=\epsilon=\pm1,\qquad H^2(\mathcal H)=\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/k\oplus\mathbb Z/h. \] The class is \((D,d_A\bmod k,d_B\bmod h)\). Its complete holomorphic endpoint group is the physical \(\mathbb C^*\). The actual shortest parameter \(w=r^3\), \(\lambda=w^{kh}\), has positive-fan physical pair \((2kh,8k(3l+1))\) and integer \(kl\). P3K.87 and P3K.91 compute every fan and every admitted winding \(Nkh\), with the endpoint and native covering maps constructed before integral characteristic naturality is applied. P3K.92 completes the infinity boundary of the marked E7 four-boundary parameter family on every fan. In its exact marking, \[ I_a(P)=-Z_a(P)-Z_a(JP)-C(P)\pmod {28},\qquad J=\operatorname{diag}(-1,1). \] The branch reflection and the infinity rescaling are given by their full character maps. The infinity root endpoint retains \(A^4D^{-4}=S_{r_0^{4n}}L^4\), its inverse scalar path on both ordinary and cap charts, and the actual transported lattice period \(-n(2\omega_1+2\omega_2)\). The two unselected \(v=1/8\) discs have the P3K.53 extension. P3K.93 evaluates that complete algorithm in closed form. Put \((x,y)^t=P^{-1}(0,1)^t\) and \(S=x^2+xy+y^2\). Then \[ I_a(P)=1-a-3(a-1)(S-1)-\frac{2a+1}{4}(S-1)(S-3) \pmod {28}. \] The proof supplies the full paired prism equations, the common first-step seed and both generator identities. Its complete images are \(\{0,6,8,10,14,20,22,24\}\) for \(a=1\) and \(\{5,7,9,13,19,21,23,27\}\) for \(a=2\), with an actual unimodular fan witness for every entry. The outstanding work is the remaining marked source-moduli generators, singular-site sectors and endpoint scopes outside the completed families just listed. In the E6 family \[ y^2=x^3+rx^2+tx+t^2,\qquad G=(0,t), \] P3K.94 completes the unselected \(r=0\) collision for the actual line \(M_6=\mathcal O(6G-O)\), suspension by \(-G\), and the quadratic reduced \(IV^*\) cap, with either signed primitive norm, each retained character, the full reference annular map and every selected lattice-basis fan. Its complete proper disc family has identity closing, so each of the corresponding marked-cover generators \(w^2=3/2\) has return zero. Its proof retains the full section \((t-t_{\rm sel})B_6/t^3\), the root coefficient \(4h\), the signed norm and every source/line period cochain. P3K.96 extends this disc construction to both full progressions \[ (a,b;m)=(6,1;3l+2),\quad l\ge0, \qquad (a,b;m)=(2,3;3l),\quad l\ge1. \] The root fibres are respectively reduced type \(IV\) and smooth elliptic. The proof gives the actual higher A2 translation, every regular graph ray \((j,1)\), both section coefficient maps, the good-root exceptional correction, the literal chord lift with central coefficient one, its full norm unit of value four, every finite character, and the complete reference-relative annular cochain. For both primitive norm signs and every selected lattice-basis fan, the proper source-disc family has identity closing and return zero. P3K.97 completes the native E6 infinity-coordinate disc at either \(w^2=3\), for both cap progressions of P3K.96. The actual source, Cartier, root, physical-circle and annular maps carry the punctured original family to a proper smooth sphere family on the full native disc. Both point and tensor Tate frames, every finite character, the transported period discrepancy and the full scalar closing are retained. Each prescribed lattice-basis fan and both primitive norm signs have marked positive \(w\)-loop return zero. The exact original parameter is \[ \epsilon=1/r=(w^2-3)^2/(3-2w^2). \] This marked loop has degree two over the original infinity meridian; no shorter original-parameter endpoint or return is inferred. The \(r=1/4\) order-three collision has the exact central line divisor \(3F-C_1+C_2\) and actual two-ruling multiplier \(8\lambda q w^{-3}\). P3K.99--100 complete its original quadratic norm-one return and every selected fan. P3K.103 carries both integral characteristic numbers through the full higher-cap product comparison for every reduced \(M_6\) cap \(m=3l+2\), both primitive norm signs and each finite character/reference in the common fixed-scalar contraction range. The vertical pair is \((-27,-12)\), native pair \((-3,-24)\); every fan has the formula and sixteen-value image of P3K.100. P3K.95 completes the E6 selected-cusp generator on the ordered \(w\)-cover for \(M_6\), suspension by \(-G\), and the quadratic cap, with both primitive norm signs, all retained characters and full reference annular maps, and every selected lattice-basis fan. The exact source, Cartier, root, exterior, normal and Cox arrows identify its full all-fan algorithm with P3K.71. On the vertical fan \(T_j\) its physical pair and class are \[ (k_M,\ell_M)=(-6-18j(j-1),0),\qquad [\Sigma_j]=-1-3j(j-1)\pmod {28}. \] Its native free pair is \((0,-6-18j(j-1))\). The actual parameter map satisfies \(r-1/3=-w^4/(3(w^2-3)^2)\), so the stated ordered loop has degree four over the original source parameter. P3K.98 extends this full selected-cusp calculation to both complete cap progressions of P3K.96, with the same fixed scalar, both norm signs, every finite character and complete annular reference. Its actual point-to-tensor line arrow, all higher root graphs, even-parameter annular map and both normal caps identify the exact vertical free pair above and every K71 fan step. The full smooth-fibre theta reflection and its target period give the actual height-one arrow; the relative \(p_1\) calculation carries the explicit regular-level cobordism and its boundary transgression. P3K.101 completes the original \(M_6,(m,n)=(2,1)\) selected-infinity initial fan with the actual moving-bundle \(c_2=-4\), physical Jin pair \((-4,8)\), native pair \((2,-6)\) and class \(27\). P3K.102 gives every selected lattice-basis fan of that same full positive epsilon loop and retained reference. Its full vertical pair is \((-4-12j(j-1),8)\); its exact all-fan algorithm has precisely the fourteen odd residues. The complete original-height period winding, relative line/tangent/collar maps, endpoint reflection and all directed ordinary-prism resets are part of that proof. P3K.104 carries both integral selected-infinity characteristic numbers and the entire fan algorithm through every reduced \(M_6\) cap \(m=3l+2\), both primitive norm signs and each finite character/full reference, using the fixed original scalar in the common strict contraction range. Its source/root/Cartier maps retain the actual selected-height unit and its full root, every signed annular cochain and the complete endpoint word. The product of the two cap families has the prescribed common boundary; matched connections prove the two integral equalities. The signed meridian lattices and separate Hopf orbit/conifold maps fix the physical line and orientation. Thus all these caps have initial physical pair \((-4,8)\), native pair \((2,-6)\), and the same full vertical and all-fan results of P3K.102. P3K.105 constructs the entire original \(M_2\) selected-infinity progression with translation by \(-3G\), every good cap \(m=3l\), both primitive norm signs, every finite character/full reference and every selected fan. Its three chronological source maps, full genuine point-to-theta arrow, ordinary and selected chart matrices, integral normal ledger and actual moving-cap clutch give initial physical pair \((-4,8)\), native pair \((2,-6)\) and integer \(-1\) directly. The full good-root graph keeps both \(E_P-E_O\) Cartier corrections, the signed annular reference and both endpoint directions. Its prescribed cap products compare the two characteristic numbers separately and retain the full K102 vertical and all-fan formulas. P3K.106 proves the original selected-I3 \(M_6\) loop with its complete moving-cap calculation, physical pair \((47,-4)\), native pair \((-1,48)\), and integer \(8\). For every signed vertical index \(j\), its physical pair is \((47-2j^3+18j^2-52j,-4)\). The full original coefficient maps, boundary-frame clutch, ordinary prisms and entire native pair reset determine every selected lattice-basis fan; 28 explicit paths from the original fan realize all of \(\Theta_7\). P3K.108 carries these integral pairs and all-fan maps through every reduced cap \(m=3l+2\), both primitive norm signs, all finite characters/full references, and both marked branch reflections, retaining the original scalar. P3K.107 completes the unselected order-three \(M_2\) loop, all good caps \(m=3l\), both primitive norms and every selected fan. Its complete compact/reference ledger and actual outer transfer give physical pair \((-3,-12)\), native pair \((-3,0)\), and integer zero on every vertical fan. Writing \((x,y)^t=P^{-1}(0,1)^t\), \(S=x^2+xy+y^2\), its full class is \(-3(S-1)(S-3)/8\pmod{28}\), with sixteen actual residue witnesses. Its source proof retains the complete theta derivative and the full reciprocal point, normal and phase maps. The selected-I3 \(M_2\) return, its remaining cap/norm/fan scopes, additional marked singular-site sectors and remaining holomorphic endpoints still require their full compact comparisons. The working notes assign no return to an unfinished attachment. Part 3.4 remains incomplete.
